assertions.note: user golden (canvas 'New Case Goldens' (artifact 6ckf8kXvoqpC3fD7jmdxMz), accepted by the user 2026-09-26): the page's prose - the upper leaf, the two headings, and the lower leaf's text - with every printed mark: 44 doubled circles 。。 and 19 single 。 (no ， 、 「」: the print has none). Characters as printed: the user changed the Wikisource-based draft to the printed 据 and 擧. The chart between 如左 and 右圖所列 is scored by golden-6-h2 in whatever form the output draws it, so its lines are skipped here (skipBetween). Page furniture is not text: the reprint's header and footer, the fold labels 法學通論 / 廣東法政學堂 and the leaf numbers. The lower leaf ends mid-sentence (德國近今哲學). No ratchet yet: first run n1 scored errors 3/590 (著 for 者, 掘 for 据, 己 for 已) and 2 acceptable swaps (舉 for 擧: user 2026-09-26, 擧 is a rare variant of 舉, both acceptable; 据 is right and 據 is not ruled acceptable), marks 18/63, 。。 0/44.

user golden (canvas 'New Case Goldens' (artifact 6ckf8kXvoqpC3fD7jmdxMz), accepted by the user 2026-09-26): the lower leaf's brace chart of the sciences as a nested list, every name and note as printed (the user, 2026-09-25: the model should understand the chart and propose a working representation; a nested list, file tree, brace drawing or Mermaid graph are all acceptable). The print, not Wikisource: 此狹義物理學… (not 之心理學), 以上三種又總名之…, 敎育學, no punctuation inside notes. Where 文學 attaches (心理學 or 倫理學) is not clear on the scan; the golden keeps it under 心理學, and either parent passes (uncertainParents; decision D10, approved by the user 2026-09-26; run_regression --no-uncertain-parents for the golden's parent only).
